latest_release.name: Eglantine v0.1.0-rc3
latest_release.body:
> **Release candidate of 0.1.0.** Please test it and report problems before the final release.


- Initial release candidate

## Linux

The AppImage is self-contained (needs glibc 2.39 or newer: Ubuntu 24.04, Fedora 40, Debian 13, Arch): make it executable with `chmod +x` and run it. The tar.gz uses your system libraries, so Qt 6 and the usual libraries must be installed.

| Build Type | Standard | PGO (Recommended) | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| amd64 | [AppImage](https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc3/eglantine-linux-x86_64.AppImage) · [tar.gz](https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc3/eglantine-linux-x86_64.tar.gz) | [AppImage](https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc3/eglantine-linux-x86_64-pgo.AppImage) · [tar.gz](https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc3/eglantine-linux-x86_64-pgo.tar.gz) |  |
| ARM (aarch64) | [AppImage](https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc3/eglantine-linux-aarch64.AppImage) · [tar.gz](https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc3/eglantine-linux-aarch64.tar.gz) | [AppImage](https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc3/eglantine-linux-aarch64-pgo.AppImage) · [tar.gz](https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc3/eglantine-linux-aarch64-pgo.tar.gz) |  |

## Windows

Windows packages are in-place zip files: extract and run `eglantine.exe`, or `eden-cli.exe` from a terminal.

| Build Type | Standard | PGO (Recommended) | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| amd64 / x86_64 (MSVC) | [MSVC zip](https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc3/eglantine-windows-x86_64.zip) |  | Use if you run into graphical issues on other builds |
| amd64 / x86_64 (MinGW) |  | [MinGW PGO zip](https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc3/eglantine-windows-x86_64-pgo.zip) | Built with MinGW clang; bundles its own DLLs, no Visual C++ redistributable needed |

## macOS

| Build Type | Standard | PGO (Recommended) | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| arm64 (Apple Silicon) | [zip](https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc3/eglantine-macos-arm64.zip) · [dmg](https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc3/eglantine-macos-arm64.dmg) |  | macOS 26 or newer. Not notarized: right-click and choose Open the first time, or run .  is inside the app, in . |

The PGO builds are the same programs compiled with profile-guided optimization (clang plus Eglantine's profile); prefer them when your CPU supports it.

detail.readme_excerpt:
Eglantine

Eglantine is a free and opensource (FOSS) Switch 2 emulator, derived from Eden, Yuzu and Sudachi - started by developer Camille LaVey. It's written in C++ with portability in mind, with builds for Windows, Linux and macOS

Compatibility | Development | Building | Download | Support | License

## Compatibility The emulator is capable of running Mario Kart World at decent/full speed depending on specs and configurations, and Splatoon Raiders at variable performances A list of supported games will be available in future. Please be patient. ## Development For development discussions, please join us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/XkS5NVPTUY) If you would like to contribute, we are open to new developers and pull requests. Please ensure that your work is of a high standard and properly documented. You can also contact any of the developers on Discord or Stoat to learn more about the current state of the emulator. ## Documentation We have a user manual! See our [User Handbook](./docs/user/README.md). ## Building See the [General Build Guide](docs/Build.md) For information on provided development tooling, see the [Tools directory](./tools) ## Download You can download the latest releases from [here](https://github.com/Djihads80/Eglantine/releases). ## Support We currently do not take in any donations for the time being If you would prefer to support us in a different way, please join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/XkS5NVPTUY) ## Star History ## Li
